regular_execution_session.rationale: The acquired primary dataset ends before NSE's August 3, 2026 equity-derivatives close-time change. NSE's 2025 F&O circulars document 09:15-15:30 regular trading; the August 3, 2026 change to 15:40 is outside the acquired period.

preopen_note.applicability: NSE states F&O pre-open applies to index and single-stock futures; this is not treated as an option execution window.

normal_session_acceptance.exclusion_rule: For a non-special observed date, if fewer than 300 unique timestamps fall inside the eligible regular-session window, classify the date as DATA_GAP_EXCLUDED and do not permit strategy trading on that date. Retain all raw rows and the exclusion reason in the audit output.
normal_session_acceptance.rationale: The frozen research requires decision-time observations during the regular F&O execution window. This rule prevents fabrication or forward-filling of a materially incomplete session while preserving the source evidence.
